name: Inside Zone Wham with Cheat Decoy

summary.motive: Exploit defensive lateral overpursuit with an inside zone Wham trap, using pre-snap speed motion as eye candy while trapping the 3-tech DT from the blindside.
summary.whyItWorks: The 3-tech is left unblocked by design, tempting him to shoot upfield where he is blindsided by the H-back’s trap block; Meanwhile, the pre-snap motion vacates the second level.
summary.failureMode: 3-technique DT reading the trap release and squeezing inside before the FB can deliver the Wham block, or sniffer FB whiffing on the trap collision.

beats.title: 1. The Pre-Snap Cheat Motion Decoy
beats.text: Z fires across the formation in full-speed cheat motion. The Will linebacker, Mike linebacker, and Free Safety all rotate aggressively left to stop the anticipated perimeter speed sweep.

beats.title: 2. The Unblocked 3-Tech Trap
beats.text: Right Guard completely bypasses the 3-technique defensive tackle, releasing directly to the second level. The 3T penetrates upfield thinking he has free penetration into the backfield.

beats.title: 3. The Blindside Wham Collision
beats.text: Sniffer fullback FB comes across against the grain and delivers a crushing Wham block on the 3T’s blindside hip, pinning him and creating a 5-yard interior highway.

beats.title: 4. North-South A-Gap Explosion
beats.text: With linebackers washed out by the motion decoy and the RG erasing the Mike, the running back hits the B-gap crease at full speed for an explosive 18-yard carry.

relations.tell: FB/H-back cuts back against the grain on a wham trap block on the 3T DT instead of leading to the perimeter.
